question: What result follows from five hundred thousand recitations by one who has restrained the senses?
premises: The practitioner has restrained the senses.
The practitioner recites five hundred thousand times.
Conquest of the senses is stated as the outcome.
inference: Restrained recitation of five hundred thousand times leads to mastery over the senses.
plain_english: One who has restrained the senses, after reciting five hundred thousand times, should conquer the senses.
